node.title: XR SL-2 deficient-rank forced-common-root syzygy census
node.statement: At every prize-row high band-proper depth with rank J_d<2d, let G_d be the evaluation points where both components of every left Pade syzygy vanish. In the residual case |G_d|>=2(h-d), the maximal selected post-strip locator set R_d satisfies 25|R_d|<=17n^2. This counts only the exact SL-2-RES currency and treats G_d as a factor forced on the whole syzygy kernel.
